methods.name: events
methods.description: Events from every calendar (or one account), soonest first: `days` from `date` (default today, 1 day; up to 62), optional search on title, place and notes. Times are local; `day` is today/tomorrow/weekday. {events: [{id, title, calendar, account, start, end, day, all_day, location, description, meeting_url, meeting}], errors?}; meeting is the video service (Teams, Zoom, Google Meet…) when the event has a join link. id (provider:…) is what calendar.update and calendar.delete take; read-only calendars (iCal feeds) give an empty id.

account.description: An account from calendar.calendars (provider:name, e.g. caldav:ik); omitted: every account.

methods.name: calendars
methods.description: The user's calendars across providers: account (provider:name), calendar name, whether events can be added.

methods.name: busy
methods.description: When other people are busy, from their calendars as the provider shows them (colleagues in the same Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 organization): `days` from `date` (default today, 1 day; up to 14). Rows: {email, start, end} for each busy period (local times), {email, seen: true} when the person's calendar could be read, {email, seen: false, reason} when it couldn't. calendar.free {with} uses it.

account.description: An account from calendar.calendars (provider:name); omitted: every account.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Add an event: title, start (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM local), minutes (default 60), optional location; account (provider:name) and calendar name pick where. attendees (email addresses) get an invitation from the provider; meet adds a video link (Google Meet, Teams). Result: {created, account, start, minutes, attendees?, meeting_url?}.

account.description: An account from calendar.calendars (provider:name, e.g. caldav:ik); omitted: every account.

attendees.description: Email addresses to invite; the provider sends them the invitation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Change an event: new title, start (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM local; the length is kept unless minutes is given), minutes or location. One occurrence of a recurring event changes only that occurrence where the provider allows it.

event.description: The event's current title, as calendar.events gave it: shown to the user when they confirm, and checked against the id.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Cancel (delete) an event; for a recurring event, only this occurrence where the provider allows it. Only on the user's explicit request; they confirm it.

event.description: The event's current title, as calendar.events gave it: shown to the user when they confirm, and checked against the id.
